name: SHETTIHALLI WILDLIFE SANCTUARY Wildlife Reserve
notes: Featuring a variety of flora and fauna, Shettihalli Wildlife Sanctuary is situated in the Shimoga district of Karnataka. The sanctuary is home to species of animals such as white-backed vultures, Indian nightjar, and white-bellied dingo.

name: Kamlang Wildlife Sanctuary Wildlife Area

name: Talley Valley Wildlife Sanctuary Wildlife Area

name: Changthang Cold Desert Wildlife Sanctuary Wildlife Reserve
notes: Situated in Ladakh, India, Changthang Cold Desert Wildlife Sanctuary is widely recognized for being a singular high-altitude sanctuary. It is also known for its chilly desert scenery, which include enormous areas of barren environment .

name: Karakoram (Nubra Shyok) Wildlife Sanctuary Wildlife Reserve
notes: In the Ladakh area, the magnificent landscapes and great biodiversity of the Karakoram (Nubra Shyok) Wildlife Sanctuary are popular with tourists. Situated within the mountainous Karakoram Range.

name: Tso Kar Basin Wildlife Sanctuary Wildlife Reserve
notes: The Tso Kar Basin Wildlife Sanctuary in Ladakh, India, is popular for its diversified birds and stunning high-altitude views. The picturesque Tso Kar Lake and the wetlands around it are known for drawing migrating species.

name: Chilapata Forest Conservation Reserve
notes: The Chilapata Forest is a dense forest near Jaldapara National Park in Dooars, West Bengal, India. The forest forms an elephant corridor between Jaldapara National Park and the Buxa Tiger Reserve, used to be home to large Rhinoceros populations.

name: Amchang Wildlife Sanctuary
notes: The Amchang Wildlife Sanctuary is a wildlife sanctuary located on the eastern fringe of Guwahati, Assam, India. The name Amchang is originated from the name of Arleng village named Amcheng located in the heart of the wildlife sanctuary.

name: Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary
notes: Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary is a wildlife sanctuary on the southern bank of the Brahmaputra in Morigaon district in Assam, India. It was declared in 1987 and covers 38.85 km², providing grassland and wetland habitat for the Indian rhinoceros.

name: Lonar Lake Wildlife Reserve
notes: Lonar lake is a lake of lagoon in Buldhana district of Maharashtra state. It was created due to a meteorite. It is the only major hoverback in the basalt rock. Its water is alkaline. Lonar Lake has been declared as Wildlife Sanctuary.

name: Satpura National Park
